## Interpretation boundary
Head9 ideal centered-logit preservation is an algebraic oracle, not a learned predictor or runtime teacher access. The final model never calls the teacher. QR changes basis construction order only, not training data order. Screen rules were computed on calibration before all fits, not on validation. Hidden NMSE and task criteria are reported separately without changing either threshold. All intervals condition on the fixed digits split and calibration set; dependent cells are not independent seeds. No confirmatory or hardware claim.
